decision: Model the ordinary Normal chain at A0 as five admitted inputs with packet groups [Melee1, Melee1_1], [Melee2], [Melee3, Melee3_1, Melee3_2], [Melee4, Melee4_1, Melee4_2, Melee4_3, Melee4_4], [Melee5, Melee5, Melee5_1, Melee5_1, Melee5_2, Melee6]. hypotheses: A different admitted ability or field exit resets the chain; a same-actor switch does not.
A gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts resets the chain; exactly 2 seconds continues.
The ordered packets within a multi-hit stage deliver at the primary impact timestamp; animation intervals and travel remain unresolved.
independent_oracles: At 1000 ATK and the level-80 target DEF factor 0.5, the level-1 seventeen-hit chain is 79 + 137 + 176 + 289 + 91.5 + 176.5 + 341 + 123.5 + 114 + 261 + 51.5 + 182 + 182 + 63 + 63 + 482.5 + 317 = 3129.5 damage.

At purchased level 8 with resonance_3 and A1 active, the projected level-9 chain with 1.4 damage multiplier is 204.4 + 354.9 + 456.4 + 749 + 237.3 + 457.1 + 883.4 + 319.9 + 295.4 + 676.2 + 133.7 + 471.8 + 471.8 + 163.1 + 163.1 + 1250.2 + 821.1 = 8108.8 damage.

The normal-chain source verifier compares all nine published ratio levels to the seventeen frozen native ATK arrays.
